description: Fork of exp509 (V2D->Linear qkv, no v_lut; trailed exp507 by +0.09 -- linear on raw 2016 dominance feats trains slowly). Two fixes: (1) LayerNorm AFTER VectorToDominance, BEFORE Linear (normalize the 2016 dominance features -> better conditioning). (2) small-std Linear init (std=0.005, bias=0) so q,k,v start near zero. out_proj/residual stay TinyMHLut(soft argmax)/LION; qkv on AdamW wd=0.1. vs exp509 (+0.09 early), exp507 1.4797, exp493 1.4806, exp475 1.4962.
